text:
Fixing the ERC errors by tying every NMOS bulk to vss. The NMOS are now sized with body effect included (`vsb` ≈ Veb). M1, M2 and M7 sit at the same source potential, so the n1/d2 balance holds. I'm also cutting Veb (larger BJT multiplicity, lower current) and raising `gmid_p` to win back headroom.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "ERC: NMOS bulks must go to vss. Tie bulks to vss and size with vsb≈Veb (body effect). M1, M2, M7 sources sit at equal potential so n1≈d2 still holds. Raise BJT multiplicity and lower PMOS Vdsat to keep headroom at -40C."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (2.5e-6, 1.2e-6, 6e-6),
    "k_r2":   (9.3, 7.5, 12.0),
    "gmid_n": (22, 14, 26),
    "Ln":     (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (16, 9, 20),
    "Lp":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    mQ = 4
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    def veb(i, m):
        return 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 * m / i)

    ve1 = veb(I, mQ)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=ve1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.3)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # Sense branch
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "d2", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mQ)
    # Diode branch
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "d2", "a", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N * mQ)
    # Loop amp: CS NMOS on its own BJT -> n1 ~ Veb+Vgs ~ d2 (balanced PMOS Vds)
    n.dev("M7", "pg", "n1", "e4", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q4", "vss", "vss", "e4", m=mQ)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.C("Cn1", "n1", "vss", 0.5e-12)
    # Output branch
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mQ)
    # Start-up
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    vref = ve1 + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 4 * I + 0.6e-6
    line = 0.5 * (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * 0.2 + 1e-3
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": 15.0,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
